The father’s entry on page 35 identifies Robert B. as Robert Barclay Glasgow, born 20 January 1783 in Rockbridge County, married Rosannah Finley in 1809 and dead near Hanna City on 15 May 1861, matching Glasgow-8. This explicit, identity-matched compiled family account materially strengthens the selected father beyond the former 2011 tree-import-only basis. The complete Harvey-to-Robert profile pair is assessed at 94% subjective confidence.
